title: 第十九章 要想富第二十章 竹君子和宰肥羊
lines: 屋子里三面都是曾经粉刷过，如今却已经斑驳的砖墙，看得出上了年头的痕迹。西面角落处摆着一个黑漆木柜，这却是最像样的家具了。旁边一个说不上是陶盆还是瓦盆的器具里，几朵杂乱不知名的小花正在怒放，给这座屋子带来了几分鲜活。
然而张寿知道，这是早上在地头新鲜连泥土挖出来现栽的。
见几个小孩子正挤在门口好奇地围观，却被守在门口的几个大人不耐烦地驱逐开来，而除却朱莹占据了唯一的一张藤椅之外，其他人不是两三个人挤一张条凳，便是只能坐在小马扎上，偏偏还一个赛一个的腰杆笔直，站在中间的张寿不禁多看了大小姐两眼。
从昨晚他把消息传到杨家后，这张藤椅就已经被人用井水刷了一遍又一遍，此时这张曾经被太多人坐过的椅子，泛着点年岁久远的油光，倒是有些古朴，可能够安之若素地坐着，犹如坐在豪宅高堂上的太师椅那样自在，也只有这位很多方面都不像大小姐的朱大小姐了。
他收回目光，清了清嗓子，来了一句言简意赅，很有村委会开会即视感的开场白：“既然人都到齐了，那现在就开会。杨老倌，你先说吧。”
杨老倌用满怀敬畏的目光偷瞥了一眼朱莹，随即就昂首挺胸，用居高临下的目光睨视其他众人，一板一眼地说：“今天，当着大小姐和姑爷的面，我来说说咱们这融水村。”
听到姑爷这称呼，张寿大为无奈。他都已经警告过了，这个该死的老头儿竟然明知故犯！
然而，不知道是杨老倌这一本正经的语气，还是他这姑爷的称呼，反正朱莹是被逗乐了。而她这一笑，下头一群想瞧却又不敢的农人们只觉得惊艳至极，一时口干舌燥作声不得。就连被张寿特意叫过来，作为村中晚辈却在角落旁听的齐良，也忍不住一颗心狠狠跳了两下。
而杨老倌见其他人都没敢做声，还以为是自己震慑住了众人，因此只当没瞧见张寿那恼火的目光，开始了他的正题。
“咱们村子从前大多是种麦子，托姑爷的福，重新修了水渠，引水灌田，这两年改种了不少水稻。之前河堤没修好前淹过的那些沙地，如今种了棉花，山坡上补种了不少树，一年再放两季柞蚕，比从前景况好多了。”
这会儿年纪最大的他红光满面，眉飞色舞地说：“如果不是姑爷说服了吴娘子花大代价下去，又是开水渠，又是选种，又是买蚕种和棉种，还减免最初一年的租子，咱们也坚持不下来！前年稻田和棉田收成一般，柞蚕死了不少，去年才好些，今年初看却是个大丰收！”
“要知道，京城做官的南人多，偏好米食，北地麦多稻少，稻米大多由南运北，所以米价素来比江南要贵得多。咱们卖的是精米不是糙米，今年只要卖出去，绝对能比从前两年的出息加一块都要多。更何况，稻田里直接就有鱼吃，愿意的话可以常常开荤。”
“至于棉田，不说钱，家家户户如今都多了两件新棉袄穿。养柞蚕就更不用说了，今年春蚕那一季，大家多挣了不少。要不是咱们背靠大树好乘凉，棉田和丝绢税，说是比稻麦要轻，可那些税吏却不是好说话的，瞧着咱们乍富，不知道要盘剥多少！”
“所以，今天我撂一句话在这儿，今后甭管姑爷说什么，咱老杨家就做什么，绝无二话！”
尽管刚刚还恼火杨老倌一口一个姑爷扣在他头上，可此时此刻杨老倌这话说完，张寿不得不承认，这个刁滑老头儿实在是会说话。
这哪里是说明情况，分明是表忠心呢！
果然，有杨老倌带头，其他人亦是齐声附和，那响应的声音仿佛在比谁嗓门大。直到朱莹身边侍立的湛金终于忍不住聒噪伸手捂耳朵，方才有人讪讪闭嘴。
朱莹却并不嫌这声音吵，她看似在认认真真听，其实不时朝张寿看上一眼，满心都在想着他之前邀请自己来此的那番话。
没想到张寿在这小小的村子里，真的很得人心……不过，他到底想要自己帮什么忙？
“之前杨老倌说的这些，只不过是从糊口到温饱，从温饱再到小康，还得有些年头。而从小康再到致富，那就更难了。既然是京城附近，要想富……”
张寿顿了一顿，硬生生把先修路三个字给吞了回去——要知道，村子距离大路并不远，从大路延伸出来的这条小路，修得很扎实，也能容纳车马通行，运送东西进出完全不成问题，否则之前赵国公府的车马也没法通行。可以说，这个村子的先天条件，是很不错的。
他轻轻吸了一口气，一本正经地说：“要想富，咱们至少不能让这村子显得这么破破烂烂的，得整修一下房子。要知道，近期之内，京城那边会源源不断有人来！”
朱莹顿时诧异了起来，立刻开口问道：“阿寿，你这话是什么意思？”
张寿转身看着正中央仿若主人一般坐在藤椅上的朱莹，笑吟吟地说：“赵国公府大小姐既然大驾光临住在这小乡村，得到这个消息的某些人，难道不会纷至沓来？”
还以为张寿不相信她之前在张家大宅说的话，朱莹不禁轻哼一声，满脸不高兴地说：“我都说了，不用理会他们，他们没胆子胡闹！谁要是敢，我饶不了他们！”
“他们兴许是不会闹事，可是，如果他们也打算像你这样住下来呢？可这些人在京城街头尚且横行无忌，更何况乡间？”
张寿笑眯眯地看着有些脾气上来的朱大小姐，故意对她眨了眨眼睛，“所以，咱们村子既然收割完了，立马晒谷打谷碾米，然后就开始整修房子吧。”
此话一出，原本正悄悄盯着张寿看的湛金和流银顿时大吃一惊。流银更是失声嚷嚷道：“你这是打算利用小姐，引得那些贵介子弟过来掏钱住宿？”
她这话还没说完，朱莹就霸气打断道：“这算什么利用！阿寿说得对，这些家伙，还真可能像苍蝇一样聚集过来。只不过，这些只会围着我团团转的家伙，不知道上进更不知道干点正事的人，可都是些成事不足败事有余的猪头蠢货！”
往日在父亲和祖母的纵容下，朱莹没少戏耍过京城那些纨绔子弟，此时她非但没有因为张寿这疑似利用自己到来的算计而生气，反而有些跃跃欲试。
“可如果阿寿你整修村里的屋舍，就是为了给他们住，那绝对行不通，就连你家那宅子，他们这些荣华富贵惯了的人，都未必放在眼里。这些猪头一个比一个有钱，一个比一个浪费，还一个比一个挑剔！”
张寿并不意外朱莹的态度，可即便猜到她不会在意，此时见人果真兴致勃勃地参与过来，他还是忍不住觉得，这位大小姐脾气确实有趣。在某些方面，她和他竟然有些契合！
闻听此言，张寿不禁嘿然一笑：“整修村子，那正是为了让他们别住在村里，以免鸡飞狗跳，扰乱了大家的生活。”
闻听此言，一群村民顿时连连点头。这里没有恶霸，胥吏除却收税也过来得少，可但凡去过城里的，总见过一两桩恶霸横行无忌的事，谁也不希望这刚有点盼头的生活就此泡汤。
见众人全都支持，朱莹却面露疑窦，张寿就笑眯眯地说：“村子整修，尘土飞扬，这些过惯了豪奢日子的贵介子弟怎么会住？而这些家伙也不可能受得了搭帐篷。”
朱莹越听越是心痒痒的：“阿寿，你倒是说啊，到底让他们住哪？”
“呵呵，山人自有妙计！”
content_en:
The three sides of the house are covered with brick walls that were once painted but are now mottled, showing signs of age. There is a black lacquered wooden cabinet in the west corner, which is the most decent piece of furniture. In a nearby utensil that could not be said to be a pottery or earthenware basin, a few random unknown flowers were blooming, bringing a bit of freshness to the house.
However, Zhang Shou knew that they were dug out of fresh soil in the field and planted in the morning.
Seeing several children crowding around the door curiously, they were expelled impatiently by the adults guarding the door. Except for Zhu Ying, who occupied the only wicker chair, the others were either two or three people crammed into a bench, or they could only sit on a small pony, and they were competing with each other with straight waists. Zhang Shou, who was standing in the middle, couldn't help but take a second look at the eldest lady.
Since he passed the news to the Yang family last night, this wicker chair has been washed over and over again with well water. At this time, this chair, which has been sat on by too many people, has a bit of the oily shine of age. It is a bit quaint, but it may be possible to sit calmly, as comfortably as sitting on the grand master's chair in the high hall of a mansion. Only Miss Zhu, who does not look like a eldest lady in many aspects, can sit there.
He withdrew his gaze, cleared his throat, and spoke a concise and concise opening statement that sounded like a village committee meeting: "Since everyone is here, let's start the meeting now. Mr. Yang, you go ahead and speak."
Yang Laoguan stole a glance at Zhu Ying with a look full of awe, then held his head high, looked at everyone else with a condescending gaze, and said solemnly: "Today, in front of the eldest lady and uncle, I will talk about our Rongshui Village."
Zhang Shou was helpless when he heard the title of uncle. He had already warned him, but this damn old man actually knowingly committed the crime!
However, whether it was Yang Laoguan's serious tone or the title of uncle, Zhu Ying was amused. And her smile made the group of farmers below who wanted to take a look but didn't dare feel so amazed that their mouths went dry and they were speechless for a moment. Even Qi Liang, who was specially called over by Zhang Shou but was listening in the corner as a junior in the village, couldn't help but his heart beat twice.
Seeing that no one else dared to say anything, Yang Laoguan thought that he had intimidated everyone, so he pretended not to see Zhang Shou's annoyed look and started his topic.
"Our village used to mostly grow wheat. Thanks to my uncle, we rebuilt canals and diverted water to irrigate the fields. In the past two years, we have planted a lot of rice. The sandy land that was flooded before the river embankment was repaired is now planted with cotton, and many trees are replanted on the hillside. There are two more tussah crops a year. The situation is much better than before."
At this moment, the oldest man's face was glowing and he said with joy: "If my uncle hadn't persuaded Mrs. Wu to spend a lot of money to open a canal, select seeds, buy silkworm seeds and cotton seeds, and reduce the rent for the first year, we wouldn't have been able to persist! The harvest of the rice fields and cotton fields was average the year before last, and a lot of tussahs died. It was better last year, but at the beginning of this year it is a great harvest!"
"You know, there are many southerners who are officials in the capital, and they prefer rice. There is more wheat and less rice in the north, and most of the rice is transported from the south to the north, so the price of rice has always been much more expensive than in the south of the Yangtze River. What we sell is polished rice, not brown rice. As long as we sell it this year, we will definitely make more than the previous two years plus one dollar. What's more, there are fish to eat directly in the rice fields, so you can eat meat often if you want."
"As for the cotton fields, not to mention the money, every household now has two new cotton-padded jackets to wear. Not to mention raising tussah silkworms. During this year's spring silkworm season, everyone made a lot more. If we hadn't been backed by big trees to enjoy the shade, the taxes on cotton fields and silk are said to be lighter than those on rice and wheat, but those tax collectors are not easy to talk to. Seeing us suddenly getting rich, I don't know how much we will exploit!"
"So, I'm going to say something here today. From now on, no matter what my uncle says, we, the old Yang family, will do whatever we do without any hesitation!"
Although just now he was annoyed that Old Man Yang kept talking about his uncle, but at this moment after Old Man Yang said this, Zhang Shou had to admit that this cunning old man really knew how to talk.
This is not an explanation of the situation, it is clearly a sign of loyalty!
Sure enough, with Yang Laoguan taking the lead, the others also echoed in unison, and the responding voices seemed to be competing with each other to speak louder. It wasn't until Zhan Jin, who was standing next to Zhu Ying, couldn't help but reach out to cover his ears that no one could stop shouting. Only then did someone shut up.
Zhu Ying, however, didn't mind the noise. She seemed to be listening attentively, but in fact she glanced at Zhang Shou from time to time, thinking about what he had said before inviting her here.
Unexpectedly, Zhang Shou was really popular in this small village... But what kind of help did he want from him?
"What Yang Laoguan said before is just that it will take some years to go from subsistence to food and clothing, and from food and clothing to well-off society. And from well-off society to getting rich, it is even more difficult. Since we are near the capital, if you want to get rich..."
Zhang Shou paused and swallowed the words "build the road first" - you know, the village is not far from the main road. The small road extending from the main road is very solid and can accommodate the passage of vehicles and horses. It is not a problem to transport things in and out. Otherwise, the vehicles and horses of Zhao Guogong's mansion could not pass before. It can be said that the innate conditions of this village are very good.
He took a breath and said seriously: "If we want to be rich, we at least can't let this village look so shabby. We have to renovate the houses. You know, in the near future, there will be a steady stream of people coming from the capital!"
Zhu Ying was suddenly surprised and immediately asked: "Ah Shou, what do you mean by this?"
Zhang Shou turned around and looked at Zhu Ying, who was sitting on a wicker chair like a master in the middle, and said with a smile: "Since the eldest lady of the Zhao Guogong Palace has come to live in this small village, won't some people who got the news come in droves?"
Thinking that Zhang Shou didn't believe what she said in the Zhang family mansion before, Zhu Ying couldn't help but snorted and said with an unhappy face: "I already told them, ignore them, they don't have the guts to act nonsense! If anyone dares, I can't spare them!"
"Maybe they won't make trouble, but what if they plan to live like you? But these people are running rampant on the streets of the capital, let alone the countryside?"
Zhang Shou looked at Miss Zhu who was a bit angry with a smile, and deliberately winked at her, "So, since our village has finished harvesting, let's dry the grain, thresh and grind the rice immediately, and then start renovating the house."
As soon as these words came out, Zhan Jin and Liu Yin, who were quietly staring at Zhang Shou, were shocked. Liuyin even lost his voice and shouted: "Are you planning to use Miss to attract those noble disciples to come over and pay for accommodation?"
Before she could finish her words, Zhu Ying interrupted domineeringly: "What kind of use is this! Ah Shou is right, these guys may really gather like flies. It's just that these guys who only circle around me, people who don't know how to make progress and don't know how to do anything serious, are all pig-headed idiots who fail to succeed and fail!"
In the past, with the connivance of her father and grandmother, Zhu Ying often played tricks on the dandies in the capital. At this time, instead of being angry at Zhang Shou's plan to take advantage of her arrival, she was actually a little eager to try.
"But if you, Ah Shou, renovate the houses in the village just to accommodate them, that will never work. Even your house, they, who are accustomed to wealth and wealth, may not take it seriously. Each of these pigheads is richer, more wasteful, and pickier than the last one!"
Zhang Shou was not surprised by Zhu Ying's attitude, but even if he guessed that she wouldn't care, seeing that she was actually participating with great interest, he still couldn't help but feel that this young lady had an interesting temperament. In some ways, she and he actually agree!
Hearing this, Zhang Shou couldn't help but smile: "The purpose of renovating the village is to prevent them from living in the village, so as not to disturb everyone's life."
Hearing this, a group of villagers nodded immediately. There are no bullies here, and the subordinate officials do not come much except for collecting taxes. But anyone who has been to the city has always seen one or two cases where bullies run rampant. No one wants this life that they have just hoped for to come to an end.
Seeing that everyone was supportive but Zhu Ying looked suspicious, Zhang Shou said with a smile: "The village is being renovated and the dust is flying. How can these Guijie children who are used to living a luxurious life live in it? And there is no way these guys can bear to set up tents."
The more Zhu Ying listened, the more she felt itchy: "Ah Shou, tell me, where should they live?"
"Haha, the mountain man has a clever plan!"
title_en: Chapter 19: Want to Be Rich Chapter 20: The Bamboo Gentleman and the Slaughtered Sheep
